{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rel'Kan''' was the planetary leader of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], and the leader of the [[P'Dar'Ken]]. In the years prior to [[Se'Lenti|the Scouring]], the Rel'Kan was [[J'Kek D'rith Kalama]].
